policy.method: Only these previously missing six route/operator-specific directed pairs can use the tighter-candidate service-road consensus. Every complete pattern on all eight reviewed routes is retained, including unsuccessful alternatives. Existing successful cantonal and supplementary paths take priority. No matcher fallback, missing call, failed consensus or detour override is admitted.

source.method: Input-dependent pfaedle extraction from the pinned Swiss PBF, adding service roads with original access/direction/turn rules. Routing profile tightens stop candidates to 20 m. No current operator itinerary or physical access certification.
